The [[Costa Rica]] 1864 Census was the first official census elaborated in the country by the {{lang|es|Dirección General de Estadística y Censos}}, predecessor of current [[National Institute of Statistics and Census of Costa Rica|National Institute of Statistics and Census]]. The total population was at the moment {{formatnum:120499}}.
